items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: And we've been on things together, in February, in Houston, as Phyllis Wheatley alumni.

ctx.x: Well, I participate in this and I go from school to school, I do clinics, I give them the history of what I know from my knowledge and experiences and what have you. And it's quite an interesting thing. And, not only in my profession; people in other professions have come out of the schools here in Texas, and they recognize them.
Like, Barbara Jordan was in -- Phyllis Wheatley she's a graduate like me, but in later years. She's younger than me.
